title: Keep the words that survived
description: A print-yellow copy proof moves surviving words into a new sentence while red edit marks distinguish additions and removals.
useCase: Preview short copy revisions while keeping unchanged words recognizable.
interaction: Choose Original, More room, or New direction; another revision interrupts the current movement.
reducedMotion: Revision changes update immediately with the same edit marks. Preference changes cancel active transitions; final copy is announced once.
limitations: Three fixed, two-line revisions with deterministic token identities. Not a text input, arbitrary document differ, or rich-text editor.
look: Saturated yellow proof with oversized ink-black words, fine red insertion underlines, a red deletion rail, and three numbered revision controls.
motion: Surviving words move from their current rendered positions into measured target boxes. Removed words rise and fade; inserted words enter after the deletion lead. Rapid reversals retain the current visual pose.
adapt: Change the short sentence pairs in `COPY`; `matchWords` assigns stable word identities using a longest-common-subsequence pass. `REVISIONS` retains those identities between the authored variants. `moveMs`, `exitLeadMs`, and `departurePx` apply to the next revision; `markChanges` updates the proof marks live.
